verdict.rationale: The trademark apply page states the filing wall up front: create a USPTO.gov account with multifactor authentication and verify your identity before you can log into TEAS or Trademark Center. It also describes the one-time verification as under 15 minutes online, with a paper alternative, and forms can be previewed without logging in before hitting the wall. For patents, docs only say registered-user status is needed to view, track and respond, so the wall is less explicit there. missing for 10: granular detail of what identity proofing actually requires (documents, provider, steps), an equally explicit pre-start statement for Patent Center filing, independent or hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed walls appear mid-flow.
